exportHint.detect: Every annotation is written as its bounding box (polygons and rotated boxes too).
exportHint.segment: Polygons; box-only annotations become 4-point polygons and multi-part ones are joined into one polygon.
exportHint.obb: Rotated boxes keep their 4 corners; other boxes and polygons use the minimum-area rotated rectangle.
exportHint.pose: Only annotations with keypoints (box + keypoints); data.yaml gets kpt_shape and flip_idx.
exportHint.classify: One class per image: the image class set in the annotator, or else the single category of its annotations. Images go into a folder per class.
exportHint.semantic: One class per pixel: boxes and polygons become PNG masks; 0 is background and your categories start at 1.

yolo.withImages: Include the images in the zip (larger, ready to train after unzipping)
yolo.importHint: A zip with YOLO label .txt files (any folder layout) and data.yaml or classes.txt. Labels are matched to the dataset's images by file name without the extension, so the images must be in the dataset first.
yolo.importStarted: YOLO ({task}): {matched} label files matched images, {annotations} annotations. Importing…
yolo.unmatched: {n} label files have no matching image (e.g. {names})
yolo.noNames: No data.yaml / classes.txt: classes will be named class_0, class_1, …
yolo.folderFound: Found {n} YOLO label files in the folder; they are imported after the images.
yolo.folderUsed: The YOLO labels in the picked folder will be imported; or choose a COCO .json or YOLO .zip instead.
yolo.classifyImages: For classification the images are the data, so they are always included.

exportCategories.title: Categories to export
exportCategories.yoloOrder: The blue numbers are the YOLO class indices, from 0 in the order above. To match a model you already trained, use the arrows to put them in the model's order.
exportCategories.empty: This dataset has no categories yet
exportCategories.noShapes: no boxes or polygons, not in the masks
exportCategories.classifyHint: An image's class is its image class when set; otherwise images whose annotations are all one (ticked) category are used and images with several are skipped. Ultralytics numbers classification classes by folder name, alphabetically, not by this order.
exportCategories.classifyCount: {classified} images with this image class · {images} with annotations

exportList.empty: No exports yet. Use "Export COCO / YOLO" on the left to create one.

exportSplit.title: Split into train / val / test
exportSplit.offYolo: Without a split everything goes to folder/train/images and train/labels; train and val in data.yaml both point there.
exportSplit.offCoco: Without a split you get one json; with a split, a zip with train.json, val.json and test.json.
exportSplit.invalid: The three percentages must add up to 100% (now {sum}%), with train above 0.
exportSplit.estimate: Images are assigned at random; about {n} images will be exported.
exportSplit.seedHint: The same seed and images always give the same split; change the seed to reshuffle.
exportSplit.layoutYolo: Inside your folder: train/images, train/labels, val/images, val/labels, …; data.yaml already points at them.
exportSplit.layoutCoco: The zip has train.json, val.json (and test.json), each with only its own images and annotations.

formatHint.coco: One .json (a zip when split), for Detectron2, MMDetection, …
formatHint.yolo: Zip: data.yaml, classes.txt + a folder you name (train/images, train/labels, …), for Ultralytics YOLO training

exportSteps.prefixExample: Files are always named <dataset>_<original name>, e.g. {image}, {label}, so merged datasets never clash; importing back here still matches the original images.
exportSteps.folderHint: train, val and test go in this folder; the zip's top level only has data.yaml, classes.txt and this folder.
exportSteps.folderCoco: COCO exports need no folder; go to the next step.
exportSteps.notReady: A step is not finished yet; click it above to fix it.

health.title: Dataset health

issue.unannotated: {n} images have no annotations (and no image class). Keep them if they are true background images; otherwise label them.
issue.fewAnnotations: {n} categories have fewer than {min} annotations, too few to learn: {names}
issue.imbalance: Class imbalance: "{most}" has {ratio}× as many annotations as "{least}". Label more of the rare class or weight classes in training.
issue.duplicates: {n} likely duplicate annotations (same image, same category, almost the same box)
issue.degenerate: {n} annotations are narrower or shorter than 2 px, probably misclicks
issue.tiny: {n} annotations cover less than 0.01% of the image; check they are not misclicks
issue.rejected: {n} images were rejected and wait for fixes
issue.taskNotRotated: {n} annotations are not rotated boxes; OBB export uses their minimum-area rectangle
issue.taskNoKeypoints: {n} annotations have no keypoints and are left out of pose exports
issue.taskBoxOnly: {n} annotations are boxes only; segmentation exports turn them into 4-point polygons (draw polygons or use SAM instead)
issue.taskNoImageClass: {n} images have no image class yet

health.classBalanceHint: Annotations per category (bar) and in how many images it appears.
health.boxSizesHint: COCO definition: small < 32×32 px, medium < 96×96, large ≥ 96×96. Many small objects: consider a larger training image size.
health.aspectRatioHint: Width : height. Very thin boxes may be mistakes, or a fit for rotated boxes.
health.heatmapHint: Where annotation centres fall in the image (normalised). If objects cluster in one area, use translate / flip augmentation.

video.title: Videos (optional)
video.hint: Frames are saved as JPG in a sub-folder named after the video, e.g. clip/clip_000m01s000.jpg (the name is the time). The video itself is deleted after extraction.
video.emptyHint: Optional. mp4, mov, avi, mkv, webm…: one frame every few seconds becomes a dataset image.
video.failed: Extracting frames from {name} failed; see the Tasks page
